recent.text: If #NYR need a winger for Sunday's game (which, with Bjorkstrand and Dorofeyev's statuses up in the air, they very well may), keep an eye on prospect Liam Greentree. He leads AHL Hartford in goals (9) and total points (16) in 19 games played, with 9 points coming in his last 7.
recent.author: Vince Z. Mercogliano
recent.quoted_text: Sullivan said Bjorkstrand's upper-body injury didn't occur at yesterday's practice. Rather, "It was just something that he's been dealing with." After talking it through with the medical staff, they decided to take a step back. His status for Sunday is TBD. #NYR

recent.text: Can you name the three #NYR from 2011-Present to have scored a penalty shot goal? There have been 25 attempts by 18 different skaters, only three put the puck in the net.
recent.author: Matthew Mugno

recent.text: On Durzi: "We're encouraged with Durz's progress. I think he's had two real good practices. He just looks way more mobile out there. He's moving stronger, more assertive. So we're real encouraged with Durz's progress. I would anticipate him being a game time decision (Sunday)."
recent.author: Colin Stephenson

recent.text: With Bjorkstrand, Sullivan said the issue is something that had been going on for a while. He doesn't know when it started, but it wasn't something suffered in practice yesterday. Asked if there's a chance Bjorkstrand might be unavailable Sunday, he said, "yes, there's a chance."
recent.author: Colin Stephenson

recent.text: Outlook sounds a bit more positive for Sean Durzi. “He’s had two real good practices. I think he looks way more mobile out there. His movement is stronger, more assertive. So, we're real encouraged with Durz’s progress. I would anticipate him being a game-time decision.” #NYR
